title: Check yourself: Changing safely, diagnosing a wrong answer and the practice

questions.stem: A new prompt is tried on 80 live cases in each arm and scores five points higher than the current one. What should the team conclude?

options.text: Adopt the new prompt, since five points is the larger number
options.says: Ruled out because "The larger number is not the better version".

options.text: Too small a sample to tell, so gather the planned numbers
options.says: With 80 cases in an arm the gap is inside chance, so the verdict is that there are too few cases.

options.text: Rerun the same 80 cases and average the two results
options.says: Ruled out because "Running the same cases again repeats the same sample and adds no information".

options.text: Extend the test only if the new prompt is behind
options.says: Ruled out because "Stopping or extending a test according to who is ahead produces false wins".

origin.section: A/B tests: telling a gain from chance

questions.stem: A new model version matches the current one on overall accuracy in a shadow run. It gains answers in order status and loses answers in refunds, an area the team guards. What does the gate do?

options.text: Ship it to everyone, because the overall totals are equal and the gains in one segment cover the losses in another
options.says: Ruled out because "A gain in one segment does not pay for a loss in another".

options.text: Average the accuracy of the two segments and ship if that average has risen
options.says: Ruled out because "An average of segment accuracies weights a rare segment like a common one and hides its price".

options.text: Ship it to half of the live traffic and watch whether any customers complain
options.says: Ruled out because "A change that ships to half of the traffic exposes half of the users to the regression before anyone has measured it".

options.text: Hold the change, since the costly segment regressed and improvements elsewhere cannot pay for that
options.says: The gate has a key for guarded segments, and a loss there blocks the change.

origin.section: Shadow runs: seeing a change before users do
